_what: One rule per lesson that recognises the lesson's RECURRENCE in an action (P336). mode warn = context beside the result; mode ask = the user is asked before the action runs. Every entry must fire on its sample and stay silent on .claude/tripwire-routine.json; audit-docs.py runs `node .claude/hooks/tripwire.js --check` and fails the push otherwise.

tripwires.why: $args is a PowerShell automatic variable; a parameter with that name is not what a splat of @args passes, so the callee runs with no arguments.
hadith_number is not unique across collections (Bukhari #1469 and Tirmidhi #2616 each have two rows); a lookup on it alone can return the wrong hadith or several.
this WRITES to hadith_library keyed on hadith_number alone; that number is not unique across collections, so the write can land on another hadith.
tripwires.sample_source: constructed from out/_q6570.py's lookup plus a PATCH - no real write of this shape was found

tripwires.why: Whisper transcribes UZ/TJ in Latin with q->k drift; its output is not a reliable check of Uzbek or Tajik narration.
-NoReview skips the subtitle review gate; on 2026-10-30 it burned a merged word into the RU salawat twice. The gate moves to after the burn, it is not removed.
tripwires.sample_source: CLAUDE.md step 7 command, with the flags the t1161 set was actually rendered with

tripwires.why: a comma list passed through -File / Start-Process arrives as ONE string, so -Scenes gets a single bogus path; declare the array inside a .ps1 wrapper.
camera movement in an image-to-video prompt makes the model invent what the still did not show (a modern facade, a door knob); prohibitions belong in the MOTION prompt.
